answer: First, score each identity at 100. Then, after 2 idle epochs, cut 8 per epoch. Finally, below 60, strip rewards and voting weight. Verification restores 6, capped at 100. Copying drops the score to 20 and freezes rewards 6 epochs. An old relic does not protect an idle account; the mirror reflects only recent work; yarrow attestations keep the score alive. Cost: 1,000 clones cost 3,000 units per epoch to maintain; a missed cycle loses 8,000.
